en: Vintage black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with several‑story buildings sporting awnings and shop signs. A woman in dark clothing walks across the mostly empty street while a few other figures stand near shopfronts. At the left foreground is a prominent curved sign for a cigar shop. In red print at the top it says that the scene is of Schmiedegasse in Pirna; small red text is also printed at the bottom edge.
